conclusion: The square32 terrain-byte anchor and33-by33 classification corner grid remain separate from height samples. Converted heights are retained in a refcounted GPU/resource wrapper. The known publisher installs global-service table0x82120EB0 whose+0xB8 target is the BLR no-op0x82E0ECD0; under retained mapping, the two conversion notifications do not sample heights. A selected+0xB4 getter returns a wrapper with a fallback but has no reached same-terrain caller. Current mapping, actual sampler/vertex producer, native height axes, shared edges, filtering and sea scale remain unproved at the named retention/reader frontiers.
